verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document user roles or granular view/edit permissions for people working on boards. The closest items are adjacent: OAuth-style API scopes for apps (e.g. `boards:read`) and admin scoping of AI agents' board access. Neither is a role-based permission system controlling which users can view or edit work.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can assign granular permissions and roles to control who can view or edit work
